items.title: Dominic James "Nick" La Rocca Interview, 1960-01-03
items.q: whether he was Edwards or Christian, they sewed it up, and that was the way I started playing.

ctx.x: Well, there's a little more story to that, Dave. Well, why don't you tell it to us? Well, in 1918, when the draft came on, Edwards was put into the Army. I came to New Orleans, and I picked up another great man and a good musician, Emil Christ.
We had Emil on the air with us a couple of weeks back, and he spoke very well to you, so tell us about that.
